_comment: Curated voice catalogue. Each entry maps a stable 'id' to a Piper voice model. Ids are a durable contract - the APU stores the selected id in its settings table - so never rename one after release; add a new entry instead. To add a voice: copy an entry, set a unique id, fill model/config/model_url/config_url from https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices, then run `syscon-tts download-voices <id>`. A site that does not want to edit this file can point SYSCON_TTS_EXTRA_MANIFEST at its own JSON (same shape) to add or replace entries, or simply drop the .onnx and .onnx.json into the voices directory, where they are discovered automatically.
_integrity: Download URLs are pinned to one commit of rhasspy/piper-voices rather than 'main', so an upstream re-upload cannot change how a voice id sounds on newly provisioned sites. model_sha256/config_sha256 are verified after every download and by `syscon-tts doctor`; a mismatch is refused. To move to a newer upload, change the commit in both URLs and update both hashes in the same release.
_licensing: PlantStar ships to paying customers, so this catalogue only includes voices whose model card states a license permitting commercial use (public domain, CC0, Unlicense, CC BY). 'license' records the DATASET license from the upstream MODEL_CARD; a voice is reported by `syscon-tts doctor` as needing review (and skipped by a bulk `download-voices`) when that license is non-permissive OR when 'license_review_required' is set true. The override exists because a Piper voice is often fine-tuned from another checkpoint, and that base can carry a restriction a permissive dataset license does not clear; 'lineage' records the provenance. Five catalogued voices (es_mx_ald, es_es_davefx, fr_fr_siwis, de_de_thorsten, zh_cn_huayan) are fine-tuned from en_US-lessac and were held on that ground. The lessac lineage was cleared on 2026-10-16, so four of them now ship; zh_cn_huayan stays held for its Unknown dataset license. See _review_lessac. Voices deliberately NOT catalogued: en_US-ryan, en_US-hfc_female, en_US-hfc_male and zh_CN-xiao_ya (CC BY-NC-SA, non-commercial); en_US-amy, en_GB-alan and en_US-lessac (license stated only as 'see dataset URL', unverified); zh_CN-chaowen (CC0 dataset but finetuned from the non-commercial xiao_ya). Any of them can still be used by a site that has cleared it - see DEPLOY.md.
_review_lessac: NOTE FOR FUTURE REVIEWERS -- the en_US-lessac lineage family. Five catalogued voices are fine-tuned (directly or transitively) from en_US-lessac, whose Blizzard 2013 training data is described as research-only: es_mx_ald, es_es_davefx, fr_fr_siwis, de_de_thorsten and zh_cn_huayan. Each was verified against its MODEL_CARD at the pinned commit (c10ece1aade47bb51c153c893d14e5bf8e5b7117). All five were held (license_review_required: true) until the lineage question was decided. DECISION: Lessac lineage cleared for commercial use by Dylan Engle on 2026-10-16. es_mx_ald, es_es_davefx, fr_fr_siwis and de_de_thorsten now carry license_review_required: false and ship cleared. zh_cn_huayan is NOT cleared by that decision -- its dataset license is stated as Unknown, a separate hold that still needs sign-off (and its 'license' field updated from 'unknown'). To reverse the decision, set license_review_required back to true on the four voices and restore the es_MX interim mapping described in _review_es_mx.
_review_es_mx: NOTE FOR FUTURE REVIEWERS -- Mexican Spanish voice selection. Both Piper es_MX voices trace to en_US-lessac (es_mx_ald -> davefx -> lessac; the other, es_MX-claude, has an undocumented base and a non-commercial sibling, so it is not catalogued). es_mx_ald was held for that lineage, with the cleared es_es_carlfm (Castilian, trained from scratch, public domain) standing in via SYSCON_TTS_DEFAULT_VOICES=es_MX=es_es_carlfm. Since the lessac clearance on 2026-10-16, es_mx_ald is cleared and is the es_MX voice again: no mapping is needed (an exact-locale match wins), and any deployment still mapping es_MX to es_es_carlfm should drop that mapping. If the lessac clearance is ever reversed, set es_mx_ald back to license_review_required: true and restore that mapping. OTHER SPANISH VOICES CHECKED (MODEL_CARDs at the pinned commit, still identical on main as of 2026-10-16) and NOT cleared: es_AR-daniela (lessac lineage, and a CC BY-SA dataset); es_ES-sharvard (lessac lineage); es_ES-mls_9972 and es_ES-mls_10246 (fine-tuned from non-commercial en_US-ryan); es_MX-ald x_low (trained from scratch, but on synthetic audio generated by the held es_MX-ald-medium, so it inherits that hold). carlfm is the only Spanish voice in Piper's catalogue with a clean lineage, and its training checkpoint is not published in rhasspy/piper-checkpoints, so a clean retrain cannot fine-tune from it -- it would have to start from scratch.
_quality: x_low (smallest/fastest) < low < medium (balanced; the APU default) < high (largest/slowest). Medium models are roughly 60 MB on disk and in RSS.

voices.name: Ald - Mexican Spanish
voices.lineage: Fine-tuned from es_ES-davefx, which is fine-tuned from en_US-lessac. Lessac's Blizzard 2013 data is research-only and excludes commercial voice-synthesis products, so this model's lineage may not clear for a product we sell, even though the Ald dataset itself is public domain.
voices.notes: Cleared 2026-10-16 (lessac lineage signed off; see _review_lessac). The native Mexican Spanish voice and the es_MX default.

voices.name: DaveFX - Spanish (Spain), male
voices.lineage: Fine-tuned from en_US-lessac (Blizzard 2013, research-only, excludes commercial voice-synthesis products), per the model card at the pinned commit. The CC0 dataset does not clear the model lineage.
voices.notes: Cleared 2026-10-16 (lessac lineage signed off; see _review_lessac). The medium-quality Castilian voice; es_es_carlfm remains as a smaller x_low alternative.

voices.name: CarlFM - Spanish (Spain), male
voices.lineage: Trained from scratch (no en_US-lessac lineage), per the model card. Dataset is public domain.
voices.notes: Cleared for commercial use: clean lineage and a public-domain dataset. Castilian (Spain) accent and x_low quality (16 kHz). Was the interim substitute for Mexican Spanish while es_mx_ald was held; kept as the one Spanish voice with no lessac lineage. See _review_es_mx.

voices.name: Huayan - Mandarin Chinese
voices.lineage: Fine-tuned from en_US-lessac (Blizzard 2013, research-only, excludes commercial voice-synthesis products), per the model card at the pinned commit. The lessac lineage was cleared on 2026-10-16; the voice stays held for a dataset license the model card states as 'Unknown'.
voices.notes: HELD FOR LICENSE REVIEW: the model card states the dataset license as 'Unknown'. Its lessac lineage was cleared on 2026-10-16 with the rest of the family (see _review_lessac), so the Unknown dataset license is now the only hold. The only Mandarin voice Piper 1.2 can run whose dataset license is not explicitly non-commercial; serves both zh-Hans and zh-Hant sites (same spoken language, only the script differs). Spot-check Traditional text before promising it.
